newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota sees 1997 domestic output up 2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Toyota sees 1997 domestic output up 2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Monday that it expects its domestic output in calendar 1997 to rise two percent from a year earlier to 3.49 million vehicles.
Toyota estimated 1996 domestic vehicle production at 3.41 million units, up eight percent from 1995, the company said in a statement.
Toyota expects domestic sales to rise four percent to 2.21 million vehicles in calendar 1997, the company said.
Toyota predicts that its exports from Japan will also rise four percent to 1.33 million vehicles in 1997, and that its overseas output will rise seven percent to 1.45 million vehicles, it said.

Toyota estimates domestic sales will rise three percent in 1996 from a year earlier to 2.12 million vehicles, exports will rise seven percent to 1.28 million units and overseas output will rise eight percent to 1.35 million vehicles, the company said.
